note: Provenance of every Agent S file copied or adapted into apps/orcel-agent (W2-02). Format follows docs/orcel/notices/donor-provenance.json (origin/wp1/licence-gates): the donor records the repository, the 40-hex pin, the original licence as recorded upstream (recorded, not judged), the preserved notice and the authorization; each file entry names its donor and source path(s) at that pin, and adds the source blobs, the decision (COPY or ADAPT) and the modifications. Each destination names its Agent S source paths and the pin in its header (checked by apps/orcel-agent/tests/test_orchestrator.py). 'references' lists files that are Orcel-original but name Agent S as a design reference.

modifications: Node and Dag: pydantic models become frozen standard-library dataclasses (the agent imports the standard library only).

parse_dag: the second (fence-aware) definition is kept, the shadowed first one dropped; returns None instead of printing; bounds added (16 nodes, 120-character names, 1000-character info, edges must be pairs of valid nodes).

Manager._topological_sort becomes topological_sort: the same depth-first reverse post-order, plus refusals for duplicate names, edges to unknown nodes and cycles (the original raised KeyError or accepted a cycle silently).
format_subtask_list and the three planner messages of _generate_step_by_step_plan copied in logic; cost, token accounting, logging, knowledge-base retrieval and web search removed.
DAG_TRANSLATOR_PROMPT renamed for Orcel; its guideline 1 (a 'plan' field the schema does not have) dropped and the rest renumbered.

AgentS2.predict's subtask state machine (requires_replan, needs_next_subtask, failure_subtask, completed_tasks, current_subtask, subtasks, subtask_status Start/In/Done; FAIL re-plans with the failed subtask; DONE records it and re-plans; an empty plan ends the task) becomes TaskOrchestrator, an Orcel Planner that returns one ToolCall or Finish per propose(). The 'empty plan means DONE' exit becomes a completion claim that must pass caller-supplied success checks.

Actions are orceld tool calls proposed to the Agent gate; pyautogui code generation, eval of model code, the grounding agent (ACI), the code agent and the permission dialog of cli_app.py are not used.

Manager: COMBINED_MANAGER_PROMPT renamed for Orcel (the screenshot becomes the window observation; verification steps left to Orcel; window text named as data); the DAG translator is re-created per translation as in the original; narrative/episodic memory, knowledge fusion, embeddings and search removed.

Worker (S3): _generate_reflection kept in structure (first turn records the task and initial state without a call; later turns reflect on the latest action and observation); REFLECTION_ON_TRAJECTORY renamed for Orcel, the code-agent paragraph dropped and each case required to start with its label; a Case 3 ('completed') reflection is passed on as advisory and never ends a subtask or a task.
flush_messages: the non-long-context strategy (drop whole turns beyond max_trajectory_length) kept; image pruning removed (Orcel observations are text).

call_llm_safe: three attempts kept, sleep and printing removed. call_llm_formatted: three attempts with the bad reply and FORMATTING_FEEDBACK_PROMPT (verbatim) fed back kept; a reply that never passes is None instead of the last bad reply.

SINGLE_ACTION_FORMATTER and CODE_VALID_FORMATTER re-targeted from one agent.* call to one JSON tool call (or a WAIT/DONE/FAIL sentinel) whose tool is offered and whose arguments match the tool's schema (agent.arguments_match). parse_code_from_string copied in logic.
WAIT, which slept in Agent S, becomes a fresh observation through orceld.

Orcel additions (not from Agent S): an observation after every action; bounds on re-plans, subtask steps, rejected claims, dialog attempts and transitions per proposal; unexpected-dialog recovery; completion verification (verification.py); events into the agent's EventLog; telemetry, provider clients and model names removed (the model is any caller-supplied object with complete(role, messages)).

references.relation: Orcel-original; design reference only (no code copied): gui_agents/s3/bbon/comparative_judge.py (blob 3ece8187fd71f9f8c1073acb9d34c93f47cbad4f) judges success with a vision model, and gui_agents/s3/memory/procedural_memory.py asks the worker to close popups it opened. Orcel replaces both with deterministic checks over orceld results.
